crossRefs.note: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.
Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it: wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t…
For Yahweh says, “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.
There is no one to plead your cause, that you may be bound up. You have no healing medicines.
As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You…
No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open…
His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

translations.web: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
translations.bsb: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones.
translations.kjv: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
translations.asv: It will be health to thy navel, And marrow to thy bones.
